official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

direct_official_checks: timestamped DTM surveys exist from 1998 onward
DTM removes surface objects to model terrain
downloads are GeoTIFF rasters in 5km zip files
heights are in metres referenced to Ordnance Survey Newlyn
transformation used is specific to survey period
metadata index records survey dates resolution transformation and geoidal model
surveys after 26 August 2016 use OSGM15 according to EA projection guidance
quality_effect: Requires parcel elevation evidence to carry its actual survey date, resolution, transformation and geoid epoch.
